kids: Hear electric strings play holiday favorites
See local school orchestra students join the band on stage
Spend a free December evening beside Lake Eola
site: Walt Disney Amphitheater at Lake Eola Park
about: Violectric is described by the City of Orlando as Central Florida's electrifying strings super group, fronted by Michelle Jones, who goes by Vinylinist. The group has returned to Lake Eola for its 14th annual holiday show.
The concert is staged at the Walt Disney Amphitheater inside Lake Eola Park. The city's listing for the show carries both a Kids and family tag and a Lake Eola tag.
Students from local school orchestras are part of the 2026 show, so young musicians in the audience can watch players close to their own age share the stage with the band.
The city's event page links to Violectric's own website for the group, to its Downtown for the Holidays hub, to the Lake Eola Park directory page and to a list of parking garages and lots.
The listing shows the cost as free, and it gives one date, Saturday, December 12, 2026, with a 7 PM start.
faq: When is the Violectric Holiday Show in Orlando?
The 14th annual show is on Saturday, December 12, 2026, starting at 7 PM at the Walt Disney Amphitheater in Lake Eola Park.
Does the Violectric Holiday Show cost anything?
No. The City of Orlando lists the cost as free.
Where is the Walt Disney Amphitheater?
It sits inside Lake Eola Park at 195 North Rosalind Avenue in downtown Orlando, Florida 32801.
Who plays at the show?
Violectric, the Central Florida strings group led by Michelle Jones, plays with students from local school orchestras.
Is the concert listed for kids and families?
Yes. The city tags the listing Kids and family, and it is part of the city's Lake Eola holiday lineup.
Where can we find parking?
The city's event page links to its page of parking garages and lots near the park.

kids: Pick a night and hear live bands at the lake
Sample classical, jazz, rock, pop and Latin folk
Enjoy free holiday music on December evenings
site: Lake Eola Amphitheater, 101 North Rosalind Avenue
Free live music from December 5 through December 20
about: DTOLive is Downtown Orlando's live music program, and its holiday run fills the Lake Eola Amphitheater with free performances from the evening of Saturday, December 5 to the evening of Sunday, December 20, 2026.

Opening weekend has The John Horton Band, billed as classic rock and folk, and Joe Fritz, billed as classical and jazz, on December 5. MacSilver Merry Irish Pirates, an Irish and electric violin act, and Sonarte, a Latin and South American folk group, play December 6.
On December 11 the amphitheater hosts Steamin' Jazz and the Shay Butter Band. December 13 has Safia and the Speak EZ, a jazz act, and Lovestruck Robot, a rock act.

The final weekends bring Sass Band and The Leo Aether Band on December 18, MALCAN'THEARYOU and Dale and the New Band on December 19, and Aleksandra Vargas and the Aletier Band and The Hannah Stokes Band on December 20.
The City of Orlando tags every DTOLive listing Kids and family, Music and arts and Lake Eola, and it links to the full DTOLive schedule on the downtown site.
faq: When does DTOLive for the Holidays run?
From the evening of Saturday, December 5 to the evening of Sunday, December 20, 2026, on select nights listed in the DTOLive schedule.
Is DTOLive free?
Yes. The City of Orlando lists the cost as free.
Where do the bands play?
At the Lake Eola Amphitheater, 101 North Rosalind Avenue, Orlando, Florida 32801.
Who plays on opening weekend?
The John Horton Band and Joe Fritz play December 5, and MacSilver Merry Irish Pirates and Sonarte play December 6.
Which night has jazz?
Steamin' Jazz plays December 11, Safia and the Speak EZ plays December 13, and Joe Fritz plays classical and jazz on December 5.
Where is the full schedule?
The city's listing links to the DTOLive event schedule on the Downtown Orlando website.

kids: Meet Santa through a calm line system
Meet the Grinch without the crowd stress
Take a break in the quiet place with snacks and water
site: East Lawn at Lake Eola, 512 East Washington Street
about: Downtown Orlando describes the night as a comfortable, low stimulation holiday experience for guests with sensory sensitivities, set on the East Lawn at Lake Eola.
The listed features are no or low music, a quiet place with water, snacks and calming vibes, fidget spinners, noise canceling headphones, a Santa line system and a Grinch line system.
The Grinch line is promoted as a way to meet the mean green legend stress free, and the Santa line is described as a thoughtful approach to meeting Santa with ease.
The event sits inside the Downtown for the Holidays program, and the page points families to that program for more event information. It is tagged Downtown Events and Lake Eola.
The page lists the cost as free and gives one date, Sunday, December 13, 2026, from 5:30 to 9:30 PM.
The organizers say they curated an evening of joy and comfort for everyone, and the page asks families to celebrate the season in a warm and inclusive setting.
Downtown Orlando also offers an events newsletter and street closure notices for families who want updates before they head to the lake.
faq: When is Sensory Night at Lake Eola?
Sunday, December 13, 2026, from 5:30 to 9:30 PM.
Is Sensory Night free?
Yes. The Downtown Orlando event page lists the cost as free.
Where is it?
On the East Lawn at Lake Eola, 512 East Washington Street, Orlando, Florida 32801.
What makes the night sensory friendly?
It offers no or low music, a quiet place, fidget spinners and noise canceling headphones.
How do we meet Santa and the Grinch?
Both use a line system designed to make the wait easier for guests with sensory needs.
Where can we learn more?
The event page links to the Downtown for the Holidays page for more event information, and Downtown Orlando offers an events newsletter for updates.
